selection.metric: Mean final logged training episode return
selection.scope: One seed shared across original and counterbalanced v1/v2, all four conditions
selection.tie_break: Lowest seed number for equal mean scores
selection.note: Final logged training rollout precedes the last gradient update; evaluation uses the final checkpoint.

uncertainty.method: 95% percentile bootstrap of whole episodes within each fixed held-out partner profile

original.corpus_note: Original v1: 1000 layouts; original v2: 1096 layouts. Protocol and other implementation details also differ.

counterbalanced.corpus_note: Both versions use 1096 layouts; original v1 used 1000.
